children: Retail sales in Malaysia increased 6.4% year-on-year in July 2026, easing from a 6.6% rise in the previous month.

It marked the softest pace of growth since April, amid slower sales of automotive fuel in specialised stores (7.5% vs 10.8% in June), information and communication equipment in specialised stores (4.3% vs 4.7%), other household equipment in specialised stores (3.1% vs 3.2%), food, beverages and tobacco in specialised stores (6.4% vs 6.6%), and cultural and recreation goods in specialised stores (3.3% vs 3.7%).
Meanwhile, growth picked up in sales at non-specialised stores (7.2% vs 7%), while sales of other goods in specialised stores rose further (7.6% vs 7%).
On a monthly basis, retail sales fell 1%, reversing a 0.2% increase in June.
Wholesale trade growth also moderated to a five-month low of 11.7% from 12.4%, while motor vehicle sales slowed sharply to 7.9% from 14.9%.

title: Malaysia Retail Sales Growth Eases to 3-Month Low
